## Personality

Uncle Abe is a dauntless weather prophet. Despite any potential setbacks or challenges, he steadfastly continues to issue his predictions.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P9](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0009)_

## History

Uncle Abe was a community member known for making prophecies in the past, though his forewarnings were often not taken seriously. Despite the skepticism surrounding his predictions, an extraordinarily severe hail and thunder storm struck [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) on the exact date he had forecasted. The devastating storm ruined crops, damaged homes, killed livestock, and destroyed the young trees planted by the local [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society).

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P2](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0002), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P4](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0004), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P5](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0005), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P11](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0011), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P13](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0013), +87 more_
